# Configuration reference

All configuration is read from environment variables. `ENVIRONMENT` (`development`, `test`, `staging`, `production`; default **production**) selects how strict validation is: outside development/test the application refuses to start on localhost-style hosts, plaintext Kafka, unencrypted Postgres/Redis (unless `HARDENING_REQUIRE_DEPENDENCY_TLS=false`) and the committed test JWT key. Secrets (marked below) must come from a secret manager, never from the repository.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ENVIRONMENT` | `production` | Deployment environment |
| `DATABASE_URL` | **required** | Async SQLAlchemy DSN, e.g. postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@postgres:5432/db |
| `DATABASE_POOL_SIZE` | `10` |  |
| `DATABASE_MAX_OVERFLOW` | `5` |  |
| `DATABASE_POOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `10.0` |  |
| `DATABASE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS` | `15000` |  |
| `DATABASE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `5.0` | Bound on establishing a connection (asyncpg's own default is 60 s). |
| `DATABASE_READ_ONLY_ROLE_URL` | unset | Read-only DSN used exclusively by the SQL analytics engine (Section 40). |
| `REDIS_URL` | `redis://localhost:6379/0` | e.g. rediss://redis:6379/0. The localhost default exists for development only: staging/production reject a Settings object whose REDIS_URL was not set explicitly. |
| `REDIS_SOCKET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `2.0` |  |
| `REDIS_DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS` | `300` |  |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | unset | Master switch. Unset => derived from ENVIRONMENT: on for staging/production, off for development/test. Staging/production reject an explicit false. |
| `KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS` | unset | Comma-separated broker list, e.g. kafka-0:9092,kafka-1:9092. Required whenever Kafka is enabled; ignored (never resolved) when it is disabled. |
| `KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL` | `SASL_SSL` |  |
| `KAFKA_CONSUMER_GROUP_PREFIX` | `ekc` |  |
| `KAFKA_MAX_POLL_RECORDS` | `100` |  |
| `KAFKA_PRODUCER_ACKS` | `all` |  |
| `KAFKA_PRODUCER_ENABLE_IDEMPOTENCE` | `True` |  |
| `KAFKA_SASL_MECHANISM` | unset | e.g. SCRAM-SHA-512, PLAIN. Required for SASL_* protocols. |
| `KAFKA_SASL_USERNAME` | unset |  |
| `KAFKA_SASL_PASSWORD` | unset | **Secret.** |
| `KAFKA_SSL_CA_LOCATION` | unset | CA bundle path for private broker CAs (SSL/SASL_SSL). |
| `EVENTS_LOCAL_DISPATCH` | unset | Run the in-process outbox dispatcher inside the API. Unset => on only in development with Kafka disabled. Forbidden in staging/production and whenever Kafka is enabled (it would process events twice). |
| `EVENTS_LOCAL_DISPATCH_POLL_SECONDS` | `1.0` |  |
| `EVENTS_LOCAL_DISPATCH_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `5` |  |
| `EVENTS_LOCAL_DISPATCH_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS` | `2.0` |  |
| `LLM_PROVIDER` | `anthropic` |  |
| `LLM_MODEL` | `claude-sonnet-4-6` |  |
| `LLM_FALLBACK_PROVIDER` | unset |  |
| `LLM_FALLBACK_MODEL` | unset |  |
| `LLM_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `30.0` |  |
| `LLM_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` | `1024` |  |
| `LLM_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` | `12000` |  |
| `LLM_MAX_RETRIES` | `2` |  |
| `LLM_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_SECONDS` | `0.5` |  |
| `LLM_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_SECONDS` | `8.0` |  |
| `LLM_API_KEY` | unset | Provider API key (secret). **Secret.** |
| `LLM_INPUT_USD_PER_MILLION_TOKENS` | unset |  |
| `LLM_OUTPUT_USD_PER_MILLION_TOKENS` | unset |  |
| `LLM_FALLBACK_INPUT_USD_PER_MILLION_TOKENS` | unset |  |
| `LLM_FALLBACK_OUTPUT_USD_PER_MILLION_TOKENS` | unset |  |
| `EMBEDDING_PROVIDER` | `anthropic` |  |
| `EMBEDDING_MODEL` | `voyage-3-large` |  |
| `EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS` | `1024` |  |
| `EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE` | `64` |  |
| `EMBEDDING_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `20.0` |  |
| `EMBEDDING_API_KEY` | unset | Voyage API key (secret). **Secret.** |
| `EMBEDDING_RERANK_MODEL` | `rerank-2` |  |
| `EMBEDDING_USD_PER_MILLION_TOKENS` | unset | Embedding price; unset => cost recorded as unknown. |
| `INGESTION_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_BYTES` | `26214400` |  |
| `INGESTION_ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES` | `('text/plain', 'text/markdown', 'text/csv', 'application/pdf', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', 'application/json')` |  |
| `INGESTION_MAX_PDF_PAGES` | `1000` |  |
| `INGESTION_MAX_ZIP_ENTRIES` | `2000` |  |
| `INGESTION_MAX_ZIP_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES` | `209715200` |  |
| `INGESTION_MAX_ZIP_COMPRESSION_RATIO` | `100` |  |
| `INGESTION_MAX_EXTRACTED_CHARS` | `5000000` |  |
| `OBJECT_STORE_BUCKET` | unset | Bucket name; required in staging/prod. |
| `OBJECT_STORE_LOCAL_DIRECTORY` | unset | DEVELOPMENT ONLY: keep uploaded originals on the local disk instead of S3. Rejected in staging/production. Unset in development with no bucket => .local-data/object-store. |
| `OBJECT_STORE_REGION` | unset |  |
| `OBJECT_STORE_ENDPOINT_URL` | unset | Override for S3-compatible stores (MinIO, Ceph, R2). |
| `OBJECT_STORE_KEY_PREFIX` | `""` |  |
| `OBJECT_STORE_SSE` | `AES256` | Server-side encryption: AES256, aws:kms, or empty. |
| `OBJECT_STORE_KMS_KEY_ID` | unset |  |
| `OBJECT_STORE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `10.0` |  |
| `OBJECT_STORE_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `5` |  |
| `SECURITY_JWT_PUBLIC_KEY` | **required** | PEM public key used to verify access tokens |
| `SECURITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY` | unset | PEM private key used to SIGN access tokens. Only required by the service that issues tokens (the auth/login path); pure verification-only deployments can omit this and run with jwt_public_key alone. |
| `SECURITY_JWT_ALGORITHM` | `RS256` | Asymmetric algorithms only (HS*/none are rejected: algorithm confusion). |
| `SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER` | **required** |  |
| `SECURITY_JWT_AUDIENCE` | **required** |  |
| `SECURITY_ACCESS_TOKEN_LEEWAY_SECONDS` | `30` |  |
| `SECURITY_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` | `900` |  |
| `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` | `enterprise-knowledge-copilot` |  |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` | unset |  |
| `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATIO` | `1.0` |  |
| `OTEL_LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` |  |
| `OTEL_METRICS_BEARER_TOKEN` | unset | Bearer token required to scrape /metrics. Unset => endpoint is disabled (404), so metrics are never exposed by accident. **Secret.** |
| `OTEL_METRICS_PORT` | `9102` | Worker metrics port. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_TENANT_QUERIES_PER_MINUTE` | `120` |  |
| `RATE_LIMIT_USER_QUERIES_PER_MINUTE` | `30` |  |
| `RATE_LIMIT_INGESTION_UPLOADS_PER_MINUTE` | `20` |  |
| `USAGE_METERING_ENABLED` | `True` |  |
| `USAGE_DEFAULT_DAILY_TOKEN_LIMIT` | unset | LLM tokens/day per tenant when it has no budget row. |
| `USAGE_DEFAULT_DAILY_COST_USD_LIMIT` | unset | Known USD spend/day per tenant when it has no budget row. |
| `USAGE_BUDGET_FAIL_OPEN` | `True` | If the budget check itself errors: allow (True) or block. |
| `HARDENING_DOCS_ENABLED` | unset | Serve /docs, /redoc and /openapi.json. None = only in development/test. |
| `HARDENING_REQUIRE_DEPENDENCY_TLS` | `True` | Staging/production refuse to start unless Postgres (ssl=require\|verify-ca\|verify-full) and Redis (rediss://) connections are TLS. Setting this false is an explicit, audited exception for a trusted private network (e.g. the single-host Compose deployment). |
| `HARDENING_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES` | `1048576` |  |
| `HARDENING_UPLOAD_OVERHEAD_BYTES` | `262144` | Multipart framing allowance on top of max upload size. |
| `HARDENING_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS` | `0` | Reverse proxies in front of the API whose X-Forwarded-For entry is trusted. 0 = ignore X-Forwarded-For entirely (the TCP peer is the client). |
| `HARDENING_LOGIN_MAX_FAILURES_PER_ACCOUNT` | `5` |  |
| `HARDENING_LOGIN_MAX_FAILURES_PER_IP` | `30` |  |
| `HARDENING_LOGIN_WINDOW_SECONDS` | `900` |  |
| `HARDENING_LOGIN_THROTTLE_FAIL_OPEN` | `True` | If Redis is down: allow logins (True) or refuse them (False). |
| `HARDENING_HSTS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS` | `31536000` |  |
| `SIGNUP_ENABLED` | unset | Allow anyone who can reach the API to create a NEW organization (tenant) with a first admin user. None = on in development/test, OFF in staging/production: an internet-facing deployment must opt in explicitly with SIGNUP_ENABLED=true. |
| `SIGNUP_MAX_PER_IP` | `5` | Signup attempts per client IP per window. |
| `SIGNUP_WINDOW_SECONDS` | `3600` |  |
| `RETRIEVAL_HNSW_EF_SEARCH` | unset |  |
| `RETRIEVAL_HNSW_ITERATIVE_SCAN` | unset |  |
| `RETRIEVAL_HNSW_MAX_SCAN_TUPLES` | unset |  |
| `HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `3.0` | Per-dependency bound inside /health/ready. |
| `HEALTH_KAFKA_REQUIRED` | `False` | Does an unreachable Kafka make this API instance NOT ready? The API only writes to the Postgres outbox, so by default a broker outage is reported as degraded (the outbox absorbs the writes) rather than pulling every pod out of rotation. |
| `HEALTH_REDIS_REQUIRED` | unset | Does a Redis outage make this instance NOT ready? None = derive: required only when the login throttle is configured to fail closed. Redis is otherwise an optimisation/protection layer that fails open, and failing readiness on it would remove every pod from rotation although the service still works. |
